notes: v652 - IMPORTANT FIX: pending limit orders were not being checked when you opened the Portfolio, so orders that should have filled sat there instead. The cause was a race between two background jobs. Opening the Portfolio starts the sell-checker (targets, stops, trailing stops) and the buy-checker (pending limit orders) one after the other without waiting. The buy-checker is deliberately built to stand aside while the sell-checker is running, so the two can never write over each other's copy of your account - and because it was started a fraction of a second too early, it stood aside EVERY time. It never ran at all. They now run in sequence, so the buy-checker starts once the sell-checker has finished. Any pending order that should already have filled will fill the next time you open the Portfolio or load fresh prices, dated the day the price actually reached your limit. The '? why' button on each pending order was what surfaced this - it reported that an order SHOULD have filled, which is the message it was built to give. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
